blocks.orig: The Safari Blue Experience is an amazing full-day sailing trip on a traditional wooden dhow to the stunning Menai Bay Conservation Area near Zanzibar where two snorkel spots filled with the most colourful corals and fish await you. During the day, you also visit a sandbank for a refreshing dip, satisfy your tastebuds with a delicious Swahili seafood lunch, and take a refreshing dive between mangroves. And, as a bonus, you might even spot some dolphins!
blocks.html: The Safari Blue Experience is a wonderful day-long sailing trip aboard a traditional wooden dhow to the beautiful Menai Bay Conservation Area close to Zanzibar, where you can snorkel at two spots full of the most colourful corals and fish. Over the course of the day you also stop at a sandbank for a cooling swim and treat yourself to a tasty Swahili seafood lunch, plus a refreshing dive among the mangroves. And, as an extra, you may even see some dolphins!
